what: Modular 'operating system' layer that lets large enterprises integrate, govern and observe AI apps and models securely and centrally.
investors: Market One Capital (lead), Next Tier Ventures, EA Ventures, Mission, Plug and Play; angels from SpaceX, Amazon, Stripe, Crowdstrike, Databricks
founder: Daniel Arenas & Ignacio Gamoneda (co-CEOs); Borja Balle (CTO, ex-DeepMind)
why_fit: Sells an AI governance/deployment layer straight to large corporates, so enterprise buying committees and ROI/risk framing are the whole game. Just raised a pre-seed and needs a crisp value story for non-technical execs.
hook: Vuestra capa de IA para grandes empresas es potente, pero el comité de compras no compra 'observabilidad': compra ahorro y menos riesgo. Os ayudo a convertir la demo técnica en un pitch de 7 min de ROI.

what: Platform (Maisa Studio) to build and deploy 'accountable' AI digital workers for enterprise operations in banking, insurance, energy and manufacturing.
investors: Creandum (lead), Forgepoint Capital International (JV with Banco Santander), NFX, Village Global
founder: David Villalón (CEO); Manuel Romero (Chief Scientific Officer)
why_fit: Enterprise AI agents sold to banks, insurers and industrial firms; classic sales-led motion with technical demos that must translate into cost/risk language for regulated buyers. Fresh, large seed means heavy enterprise pipeline push now.
hook: Sois la primera startup española en los Gartner de agentes de IA. Cuando el CIO de un banco ve la demo piensa 'suena a riesgo'. Convierto esa demo en un caso de ahorro y control auditable en 7 minutos.

what: AI agents that audit freight invoices, detect shipment losses/damages and automate claims and recovery of logistics overspend for shippers.
investors: Seedcamp & Yellow (Glovo founders Oscar Pierre & Sacha Michaud) (co-lead), Baobab Ventures, Kima Ventures, Enzo Ventures, OPRTRS Club, Masia; angel Dídac Lee
founder: Pablo Cousin (founder, ex-founding team at Rever)
why_fit: AI applied to logistics operations, sold B2B to companies with freight spend (early clients Amphora Logistics, Nude Project, Ecoalf). Just raised and expanding commercially across Europe, so demo-to-enterprise-pitch conversion is live.
hook: Decís que las empresas pierden hasta el 10% de su gasto logístico. Eso es exactamente el titular de un pitch enterprise. Os ayudo a pasar de 'agentes de IA' a un número de ahorro que el CFO firma.

what: AI agents that automate and run B2B sales operations (prospecting, enrichment, outreach) for revenue teams.
why_fit: AI applied to a core enterprise operations function (sales), B2B sales-led with demos. Reportedly the largest round for a Spanish-fund-led GenAI-native company at the time, so they're scaling enterprise GTM and fighting demo-vs-value gaps themselves.
hook: Irónicamente, una startup que automatiza ventas B2B también tiene que vender su propia demo a grandes cuentas. Os preparo el pitch de 7 min que convierte la demo de agentes en ROI de pipeline.

what: Digital freight platform (TMS, freight exchange and digital forwarding) that digitalises road-transport and logistics companies.
investors: ENION Partners, Inclimo Climate Tech Fund, Grup Bonanova; earlier seed angels Mario Vicente, René de Jong, Kike Corral
founder: David Vives Colilles (CEO); Mike Jonathan Cuingnet (co-founder)
why_fit: B2B SaaS sold to transport/logistics enterprises with product demos; raising a Series A and needing to pitch value (cost per shipment, digitalisation ROI) to large freight players.
hook: Digitalizar transportistas se enseña con una demo de pantallas; se vende con € ahorrados por envío. Os ayudo a montar el pitch enterprise de 7 minutos para cerrar cuentas grandes durante la Serie A.

what: AI-agent-based platform that automates and optimises last-mile Out-Of-Home (OOH/PUDO) delivery logistics for retailers and carriers.
investors: Sego Finance, Suma Capital, Ona Capital Private (prior €1.2M in 2022)
founder: Xavi Valverde, César Valencia & Iván Lorca (co-founders; Iván Lorca co-founder/spokesperson)
why_fit: Sells a last-mile network + AI tooling B2B to retailers and carriers, with a strong efficiency story (claims 35% lower operating cost). Just raised and internationalising, so enterprise retail pitches are front and center.
hook: 5.000 puntos PUDO y -35% de coste operativo es una historia enterprise buenísima... si no se pierde dentro de una demo. Os la convierto en 7 minutos de ahorro para el director de operaciones del retailer.

what: Digital freight-forwarding marketplace that connects exporters/importers with transport providers and digitalises international logistics.
investors: Successful Fund (lead), Angels (Juan Roig's investment vehicle), T-Valley, ENISA, angel Lluís Costa
why_fit: B2B logistics platform digitalising international freight, backed by Juan Roig's network (Mercadona/Lanzadera orbit). Early seed, selling to exporters/corporates, so the enterprise pitch and demo polish are exactly the stall point.
hook: Con Angels de Juan Roig detrás tenéis puertas abiertas a grandes industriales; lo que falta es un pitch que hable su idioma. Os ayudo a pasar de la demo del marketplace a un pitch de 7 min de coste y riesgo logístico.
channel: warm intro via Angels (Juan Roig) / Lanzadera

what: SaaS that lets retailers and logistics operators centralise and optimise last-mile operations (real-time tracking, incident management, routing).
investors: GoHub Ventures (Global Omnium corporate fund) (lead), Demium Capital; angels Julián Recuenco (ex-CEO SEUR), Juan Quintana (ex-MD Dachser Iberia)
founder: Alfonso Porras, Carlos Urban & David Montesinos (co-founders)
why_fit: B2B last-mile SaaS sold to retailers and 3PLs (30+ clients, ~500 routes/day), with logistics-veteran angels for warm enterprise intros. Early-stage with a technical product that needs an ROI-first enterprise narrative.
hook: Tenéis a ex-SEUR y ex-Dachser en el cap table: la puerta a grandes operadores está abierta. Convierto vuestra demo de rutas en un pitch de 7 minutos sobre coste por entrega e incidencias evitadas.

what: AI-driven supply-chain planning SaaS (Supply Chain Planning Studio) covering demand forecasting, production planning and procurement.
round: Series A, €10M, 2025-02 (prior €3M Seed led by Samaipata, 2024)
investors: Samaipata & Burda Principal Investments (co-lead), Acurio Ventures, Draper B1, All Iron Ventures, Angels Capital
founder: Álvaro Bernabé (CEO); Sergio Alemany & José Tomás Carrascoso (co-founders, ex-Deloitte/NTT Data)
why_fit: Pure supply-chain planning SaaS sold to large manufacturers/retailers; founders come from enterprise consulting, so classic enterprise sales with heavy demos. Recently raised Series A and pushing international enterprise expansion (UK, Italy, France).
hook: Supply Chain Planning Studio impresiona en demo, pero el VP de operaciones de un gran fabricante compra reducción de stock y de roturas. Os ayudo a destilar eso en un pitch de 7 minutos de ROI.

what: Agentic 'operating system' (agent 'Teno') that orchestrates physical operations (purchasing, production, transport) as a layer over ERP/WMS/TMS for retail, distribution and manufacturing.
investors: Plus Partners (lead), Bynd, Soldiers Field; group of angels
founder: Ricardo Martínez Finger & Oleksandr Shcherbina (co-founders, ex-Jüsto.mx)
why_fit: Supply-chain orchestration AI sold to retail/distribution/manufacturing operators; already >€1M ARR and just raised a seed to launch commercially in Spain, so they need an enterprise value pitch for Spanish/US expansion. (HQ: Spanish-ecosystem company launching in Spain; exact HQ city not published in sources.)
hook: Teno orquesta compras, producción y transporte sobre el ERP: eso es visibilidad y ahorro, no 'otra demo de IA'. Os ayudo a empaquetarlo en un pitch de 7 min de coste/riesgo para abrir España y EE.UU.

what: Supply-chain finance platform that funds purchase orders through to payment for retail and apparel supply chains (sustainability-linked).
round: Series A, $12M (≈€8.3M, equity $9M + debt $3M), 2023-01 (plus €50M BBVA debt facility, 2023-10)
investors: Quona Capital (lead equity), Mundi Ventures, Finch Capital, Working Capital Fund; debt from BBVA Spark, EBN, Zubi Capital
why_fit: Supply-chain tech sold to large retail/apparel corporates and their supplier networks (150+ suppliers across 13 countries); enterprise, procurement-led sales where the value case (working capital, resilience, ESG) must beat a complex product story.
hook: Financiación de cadena de suministro ligada a sostenibilidad es un relato perfecto para un comité de un gran retailer, si se cuenta como caja liberada y resiliencia, no como producto fintech. Os lo afilo en 7 minutos.

what: AI-powered collaborative robots that automate mobility and handling in warehouses and distribution centres (order picking, truck load/unload).
investors: Basque Tek Ventures (Basque Government-backed fund / Tecnalia)
why_fit: Intralogistics/warehouse-automation tech born from Tecnalia research, selling to large distribution/manufacturing operators; validating prototype with enterprise customers in 2025 ahead of 2026 European commercialisation, exactly when demo-to-value pitching matters most.
hook: En 2025 validáis prototipo con grandes operadores: ese es el momento de clavar el pitch. Convierto la demo de los robots en 7 minutos de ahorro por pedido y menos riesgo operativo en el almacén.
channel: warm intro via Tecnalia / Basque Tek Ventures
